title: hieracium hepaticum
intro: Hieracium hepaticum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It has been used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, particularly in treating liver and gallbladder issues due to its ability to stimulate bile production and improve liver function. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium hepaticum include its cholagogic and hepatoprotective properties, which help to stimulate the flow of bile and protect the liver from damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
